Question 2
?

Given the curve r(t)=⟨et,1+t2⟩, find all of the points at which the tangent to the curve is perpendicular to the vector ⟨0,1⟩.

a
 (1e,2)
b
 (1,1)
c
 (1,1) and (1e,2)
d
 (1,1) and (e,2)
e
 (e,2) and (1e,2)
